meta.title: Belong for Couples
meta.description: Belong is a shared space for two: a plan for the day, photos of the day, chat with voice notes, letters for later, a film list, dreams and games for couples. Join the waitlist.
meta.ogTitle: Belong: your life together, in one place

hero.eyebrow: For couples · Coming to iOS and Android
hero.title: Your life together, in one place
hero.lead: Belong is a shared space for two. Plan the day, share a photo of it, write letters for later, pick tonight's film and turn wishes into goals. Everything connects.
hero.note: Free to start. One subscription covers you both.
hero.float2: Night in a tent by a lake

how.title: One wish, all the way to a memory
how.lead: Most couple apps do one job. Belong links them up, so a dream you mention over breakfast can end up in your shared timeline.
how.s1d: Gifts, trips and experiences, with a price and a link. Your partner can quietly reserve a gift.
how.s2t: Turn it into a shared goal
how.s2d: Break it into steps, give each step an owner and save up together.
how.s3d: “Buy tickets to Tokyo” shows up in Yulia’s plan for today, with its deadline.
how.s4d: Photos and the moment it happened go into your shared timeline.

day.title: Small moments that keep you close
day.lead: Belong fits into the day you already have: half a minute in the morning, one tap at lunch, one kind sentence before bed.
day.mText: Pick a mood and an energy level. Your partner sees you’re tired before asking you for anything.
day.dTitle: A tap that says “thinking of you”
day.dText: One tap sends a soft buzz to your partner’s phone. Notes can stay locked until a date, like the morning of your anniversary.
day.chatHim: Morning! Calls until lunch, then dinner at my parents’ tonight, remember?
day.chatHer: I remember 🙂 I’ll bring the apple pie
day.eText: Switch between your tasks, shared ones and your partner’s. A dot shows whose task it is.
day.nText: Before bed, write one thing you’re thankful for. Igor reads it with your “good morning”.
day.nQuestion: What are you thankful to Igor for today?
day.wText: Three questions: what went well, what was hard, what you want next week. It’s the weekly check-in many couples therapists recommend.

play.title: Date Match
play.lead: Swipe 10 date ideas. Then pass the phone or send a link to your partner. You’ll only see the ideas you both said yes to.
play.step3: See your matches and share the card
play.wheelTitle: Can’t decide? Spin the date wheel
play.wheelLead: Pick a budget and where you want to be. The wheel chooses for you.

dist.title: Far apart, still in the same day
dist.lead: Belong is built for couples who live apart too: for work, for study, or because of the war.
dist.f1: Both time zones on your home screen
dist.f2: One tap on “I’m safe” sends your partner a calm notification
dist.f3: Widgets with your partner’s mood and a countdown to the next meeting
dist.f4: A shared goodnight, even 7 hours apart
dist.safeText: Let Igor know you’re okay without typing a word.

wid.title: Always on each other’s home screen
wid.lead: Belong lives where you look a hundred times a day. Draw something, and in a few seconds it’s on your partner’s home screen.
wid.l1: Your partner’s mood and local time
wid.l2: A countdown to your next meeting
wid.l3: Doodles that land on their screen
wid.l4: On the lock screen too, where the phone supports it
wid.padLabel: Drawing area. Draw with your mouse or finger.
wid.phoneAlt: Igor’s home screen with Belong widgets: Yulia’s mood, the countdown and her latest doodle
wid.l5: Today’s tasks you can tick off right on the home screen

priv.title: Yours, theirs, ours
priv.lead: Everything in Belong has an owner, and color shows who. You decide what to share.
priv.mineText: Private notes, goals and photos only you can see.
priv.theirsText: What your partner keeps to themselves stays theirs.
priv.oursText: Plans, goals and the timeline you both see.
priv.l1: No location tracking. Belong never asks where you are.
priv.l2: Secret swipes are revealed only when you both say yes.
priv.l3: Only the two of you can read your shared space.
priv.l4: If you break up, each of you exports your own data, and the shared space is archived instead of quietly deleted.
priv.l5: No guilt streaks. Missing a day costs you nothing.

month.title: Our month apart
month.lead: On the first of each month Belong sums up your month: kilometres between you, “thinking of you” taps, doodles and days until you meet. It comes as a story card made to share, and once a year you get the big one.
month.note: Distance and time difference use your cities. Taps, doodles and mood are example numbers.

wl.okText: We’ll email you when the beta opens.
wl.shareTitle: Know a couple who’d love this?

faq.title: Questions couples ask
faq.a1: We’re building it now. Join the waitlist and we’ll email you when the beta opens on iOS and Android.
faq.a2: Yes. The core of Belong is free for both of you. Belong+ adds unlimited goals, all the games and the AI helper, and one subscription covers you both.
faq.q3: Do we both need the app?
faq.a3: Yes, Belong is made for two. One of you creates a shared space and invites the other with a code or a link.
faq.q4: Who can see what I add?
faq.a4: You choose for each item: just you, or both of you. Color shows who owns what, and shared things use both colors.
faq.q5: Does it work for long-distance couples?
faq.a5: Yes. You get both time zones, widgets, “I’m safe” check-ins and games you can play while apart.
faq.a6: English and Ukrainian at launch. More will follow.
